description: This file defines the ParserModifyLayoutView class which extends ModuleBuilderParser to handle layout modifications within the SuiteCRM module builder, including initialization, layout management, and field handling.

classes.name: ParserModifyLayoutView
classes.description: A parser class for modifying and handling layouts in SuiteCRM's module builder, providing methods for layout loading, saving, and field management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with module, view, and layout details, including determining source files and loading field definitions.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns the set of fields available for layout modification, filtering out those already used in the current view.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the current panel layout definitions.

methods.name: writeWorkingFile
methods.description: Saves the current view definitions to a working file.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the layout to a custom file and clears related cache for immediate reflection.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads view definitions for a specific module and view from the source file.

methods.name: _loadLayoutFromRequest
methods.description: Loads layout configuration submitted via HTTP request, updating the internal view definitions accordingly.

methods.name: _padFields
methods.description: Ensures each panel row has the correct number of columns by inserting empty placeholders where needed.

methods.name: _addField
methods.description: Adds a new field with specified properties to a panel, creating a new row if necessary.

methods.name: _getModelFields
methods.description: Retrieves all fields from the data model and the original layout definition, filtering out non-displayable fields.

methods.name: _parseData
methods.description: Converts panel data into a standardized display format for editing or rendering.

methods.name: _getOrigFieldViewDefs
methods.description: Loads and processes the original layout definitions from the module's metadata source file.
